name: mastermind-ad-engine
description: Create static ads people actually feel: billboards, posters, print, and social statics. A 7-step method (emotional truth, category flip, punchline, visual twist, micro-tribe, platform fit, taste test) with scoring tools, a 15-minute quickstart, a cold creative-director critique, A/B variants, a launch checklist, and rendered SVG mockups, including ads with people drawn as bold vector figures.

interface.longDescription:
Mastermind Ad Engine turns the model into a creative director for static ads: billboards, street and transit posters, print, social statics, and email headers.

What it does:
- Builds an ad end to end with a 7-step method: find the emotional truth your audience hides, flip the category's default belief, write a punchline that lands in three seconds, choose a visual format that delivers the feeling, sharpen the micro-tribe, adapt to the placement, and score the result.
- Renders every ad as a self-contained SVG mockup at the right proportions (billboards, posters, Instagram, LinkedIn, stories, email).
- Puts people in ads when the truth lives in a body: draws them as bold, pictogram-style vector figures, or writes a photo brief and composites your own photo into the layout in black and white.
- Critiques existing ads with a scorecard and concrete rewrites, including a blind cold review that ranks variants.
- Generates 2x2 A/B variants, runs a pre-launch checklist, remixes ads that flopped, and scales one idea into 5 to 20 ads.

Who it's for: founders, marketers, product managers, designers, and small businesses who need ads that make people stop, without an agency.

Limitations: it does not generate photographs or connect to any service; it draws vector figures and writes photo briefs. Mockups are for judging ideas, not print-ready artwork; final files still need to be produced to the media owner's or printer's specification. No data leaves the conversation.
defaultPrompt: Make a billboard for my café that opens at 5:30 a.m. for night-shift workers.
Rate this ad and tell me exactly what to fix.
Give me four A/B variants of this Instagram ad.
